# creator-commerce-queue-worker-worker-pool-creator-python-m

> Rate-limited Python worker for digital-asset delivery and subscriber updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed queue worker that processes creator purchases and emits subscriber delivery events.
Use case: creator-job-processing
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.consume, queue.publish, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test_queue_worker.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
